lines.en: I walk step by step on my hind legs.
My broad muzzle sweeps along the grass.
I chew as I walk, wasting nothing.
I keep to the middle of the herd.
Tail out straight to balance me.
I flatten the tall grass ahead.
I head for the green by the river.
My steps fall in a steady rhythm.
My herd calls from ahead.
I stop to let the young pass.
The mud is soft; my steps sink.
I look up; the canopy hides the sky.
A fallen trunk blocks the way; I step over it.
I turn and rejoin the herd.
My prints sink deeper than the others'.
I run a few steps, then walk again.
I stand and chew my cud slowly.
I lower my head close to the grass.
Wind carries my call away.
I tilt an ear to a distant sound.
The young ones are running in the herd.
I lift a forelimb, then set it down.
Sunlight lies on my back.
I call once, and it carries.
A few heads lift in answer.

lines.zh: 我慢慢眨眼，鸭嘴还张着。
lines.en: I blink slowly, duckbill still open.

lines.zh: 这里的草够我们吃很久
lines.en: There's grazing enough here for a long while.
I twitch my hide.
Flies settle on my flank.
I swing my tail at them.
You're standing there alone.
I raise my head; my neck is tall.
You don't look like you belong here.
I back half a step toward the herd.
If you come near, come slowly.
I call once — a warning.
You're on my path.
I tilt my head at you, calm.
This body is heavier than you think.
I don't mind you watching.
But don't block the young.
I take half a step forward.

lines.zh: 低沉的叫声从喉咙滚出来。
lines.en: A deep call rolls from my throat.
I stagger back half a step.

lines.zh: 腿上挨了一下，我屈起膝。
lines.en: A blow lands on my leg; I bend the knee.
Blood seeps through my thick hide.
I move back, shielding the young.
I turn broadside to block.
I'm breathing loudly.
I can still stand.
The herd is calling all at once.
I can bear this much.
Are those tender leaves?
I smell fresh grass.
Hold it up; I can reach.
I can eat that.
I come slowly. I won't snatch.
Just put it on the ground.
That smells fresh.
I've still got something else in my mouth.

lines.zh: 鸭嘴的宽吻，一口要更多。
lines.en: This broad duckbill needs more per mouthful.
Step back and I'll eat in peace.
I turn slightly to let you by.
You hit my leg and bounced off.
With my bulk, even a corridor is tight.
I step back and clear the way.
My tail brushes your shoulder.
That much jostling is nothing.

lines.zh: 我宽扁的吻差点顶到你脸上。
lines.en: My broad bill nearly bumped into your face.
I'll shift over — don't rush me.
Our bumping has scattered the herd.
Best not to stand behind me.
I know your call.
Let's follow this riverbed together.
I call, you answer. That's enough.
The young walk in the middle.
You lead; I'll guard the rear.
This meadow feeds the whole herd.
If there's danger, I call first.
Our pace matches.
When we lower our heads, I'm beside you.

lines.zh: 这季节过去，我们就往南
lines.en: When the season turns, we go south.
I lower my head and take a clump.
This much goes in one mouthful.
I'll eat what falls too.
My snout is broad as a duck's bill.
Too dry; I can't bite it.
Bits of leaf cling to my muzzle.
I chew slowly. No rush.
You dropped this? I won't refuse.
This mouthful is all sand.
I shake my head to throw off the dirt.
A shadow at the treeline; I raise my snout.
I raise my head that way.
Wrong scent — something unfamiliar.
One call and the herd hears.

lines.zh: 我往前一步，落叶被踩碎。
lines.en: One step forward, and the leaves crunch.

lines.zh: 我朝那边叫了一声长的
lines.en: I call once, long and loud.
The herd has gone quiet.
I turn broadside.
It's approaching the herd.
I can't yield this line.
I whip my tail once.
It stops, and I check my step.
I wait for it to step first, then follow.
Now. Everyone back.
I press forward, step by step.
It circles half around, and I shuffle along.
I stand between it and the herd.
It's a good deal smaller than I.
But I won't charge first.
It lifts a leg, and I lift mine.
My steps push it back.
I raise my forelimbs as if to slap down.
It's deciding whether to try.
I show it my weight.
It's stepped back.
One more step and I act.
It stopped.
Then that's that.
I fall back to shield the young.
I bring a forelimb down.
My tail sweeps with a whistle.
I kick out.
It's knocked back several steps.
My weight comes down on it.
I bite, but not hard.
It dodged that one.
I swing my tail again.
My call is louder than my blow.
It has retreated far off.
I don't chase.
The herd settles again.
I lower my head to check the young.
They're all here. Good.

lines.zh: 我从河边的草丛站起来
lines.en: I rise from the riverside grass.

lines.zh: 这具身体比我预想的大
lines.en: This body is bigger than I expected.
I try two steps first.
The grass underfoot is soft.
My herd calls in the distance.
I answer with a call.
A young one runs over to look at me.
The grass here is tall.
I lower my head for the first bite.
The sun is warm on my back.
I walk toward the herd.
Wind comes off the river.
The herd is on the move.
I hurry a few steps to catch up.
I know where I should be.
I herd the young into the middle.
The herd has drawn together.
We set off.
My hide burns with heat.

lines.zh: 我从坡上摔下，腿压着了
lines.en: I fall from a slope and land on a leg.
River water covers my back.
The blast leaves me unsteady.
An arrow sticks in my flank.
A force pins me in place.
Not enough grass; I've grown thin.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我旁边，我跳起来
lines.en: Lightning strikes beside me; I bolt.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有地，我甩着尾巴。
lines.en: No ground in the void; my tail lashes.
